Key Phrases
Every phrase: romaji first (read it out loud as written), then the Japanese script to show people, then what it means.
SHOW-THE-WAITER card · no fish, in Japanese
魚と魚介類が食べられません
魚・魚介類は一切食べられません。
なると・かまぼこ・かつお節・海苔は抜いてください。
肉・鶏・野菜は大好きです。
(I cannot eat fish or seafood at all. Please leave out narutomaki, kamaboko, katsuobushi flakes and nori seaweed. Meat, chicken and vegetables I love.)

Interest Profile
bars & funclub meeting people / funclub arcades & game bars maid / concept cafes swords · katana · samurai · ninja anime & pop culture urban atmosphere - live it, not checklist it food: yakiniku · tonkatsu · ramen · kushikatsu - NO seafood, ever · hidden-fish watchlist: narutomaki (the pink-spiral slice on ramen/udon = fish-paste cake) and all kamaboko (pink/white fish-paste slices in soups) · veto phrase at order: "Narutomaki nashi de onegaishimasu" (without narutomaki please) · general shield: "Sakana nashi de" (no fish) · also fishy defaults: dashi broth (bonito), katsuobushi flakes on okonomiyaki/takoyaki-style dishes history+nature: only true must-sees, roam briefly, no hikes culture: absorbed through streets & people
Hard Rules
  • Max ~1 hour queue - timed tickets / reservations / lotteries always
  • Trains only, no buses (sole exception: ITM limousine Dec 27)
  • No revisiting 2025 places - funclub districts exempt
  • No hiking · nature = brief roam at true must-sees only
  • THE FULL KIT (mandatory for every addition): every venue/location enters the board with ① a Google Maps link, ② BOTH a step-by-step train route (correct line badges, boarding AND get-off station map finders) AND a taxi option — unless walking is closer, stated explicitly — ③ a taxi flash card whenever a taxi is an option, ④ a booking chip (🎟) wherever reservations exist, ⑤ the return route (Route HOME or in-act), ⑥ fares and last-train notes where relevant. Same-building additions inherit the host venue’s kit. Walking-only cities (Kanazawa, Narita) declare it once instead of faking train routes. No buses, ever.
  • PAYMENT SECURITY (post Aug-28 phishing attempt): NO card entry, "verification", or AVS check EVER happens through a message link · WhatsApp, SMS, email, or even a chat inside Booking/Airbnb. Anything real is visible by opening the Booking.com / Airbnb APP directly. Hotels never verify cards via third-party pages. Any "your booking will be cancelled in 24h" message = scam by default · verify in-app, report the property message, block the sender. Expect follow-up waves ("refund department", "verification failed") · same rule applies. GO app note: the card is temperamental in GO specifically - if in-app payment fails, set the ride to PAY IN CAR and settle with the driver (contactless/cash); hailing with preset destination still works fully.
  • Wash 1-2 days before every checkout - cross hotel legs clean
  • Dryer islands: Kanazawa · Calm House · Glass · Castle Plaza
  • Pack for ~4-5 days of clothes - laundry exists on every leg
  • Apps: Google Maps (primary) · Uber · GO · LINE

🆘 Emergency card AIG policy · 24/7 Hebrew medical desk · Japan 110 / 119 · embassy · lost passport or card · every number dials from here
MEDICAL · call before you go anywhere that isn't a blue-light emergency
🩸 Medical alert · G6PD tap to open · show to any doctor or pharmacist
Medical alert · show this to any doctor or pharmacistG6PD deficiency · G6PD欠損症です。溶血を起こす薬は禁忌です。 · "G6PD kesson-shō desu. Yōketsu o okosu kusuri wa kinki desu." (G6PD deficiency: drugs that cause hemolysis are contraindicated).
Pharmacy in Japan: painkiller = loxoprofen (Loxonin ロキソニン) or acetaminophen (Calonal カロナール / Tylenol) · avoid high-dose aspirin (Bufferin), sulfa antibiotics, nitrofurantoin, dapsone, primaquine, methylene blue · your own doctor's list wins over this one, carry it in the phone.
Food: fava beans = そら豆 / ソラマメ soramame · boiled in the pod as an izakaya snack, roasted "ikari mame" in konbini snack mixes and bar otoshi bowls, in some Nankinmachi Chinese dishes · read the packet, refuse the bowl.
Apartments: naphthalene mothballs (ナフタリン) live in Japanese closets and futon cupboards · check on day one in every base, bag them and move them out of the bedroom.
Tell the AIG desk once before the flight so it is on the file.
DOCTOR · 医師へ
私はG6PD欠損症（グルコース-6-リン酸脱水素酵素欠損症）です。溶血性貧血を起こす薬剤は禁忌です。サルファ剤、プリマキン、ダプソン、ニトロフラントイン、メチレンブルー、高用量のアスピリンなどを避けてください。処方の前にご確認をお願いします。
"Watashi wa G6PD kesson-shō desu. Yōketsu-sei hinketsu o okosu yakuzai wa kinki desu." · I have G6PD deficiency; drugs that cause hemolytic anemia are contraindicated: sulfa drugs, primaquine, dapsone, nitrofurantoin, methylene blue, high-dose aspirin. Please check before prescribing.
PHARMACY · 薬局で
G6PD欠損症があります。溶血を起こす成分が入っていない薬をお願いします。アスピリン（高用量）とサルファ剤は避けたいです。ロキソプロフェン（ロキソニン）かアセトアミノフェン（カロナール）なら大丈夫です。
"G6PD kesson-shō ga arimasu. Yōketsu o okosu seibun ga haitte inai kusuri o onegaishimasu." · I have G6PD deficiency; please give me medicine without ingredients that cause hemolysis. I want to avoid high-dose aspirin and sulfa drugs. Loxoprofen (Loxonin) or acetaminophen (Calonal) are fine.
RESTAURANT · お店で
そら豆（ソラマメ）のアレルギーがあります。そら豆、そら豆の粉、いかり豆が入っていない料理をお願いします。お通しにそら豆が入っていたら教えてください。
"Soramame no arerugī ga arimasu. Soramame ga haitte inai ryōri o onegaishimasu." · I have a fava-bean allergy. Please give me dishes without fava beans, fava-bean flour or roasted ikari-mame, and tell me if the otoshi contains them. (Framed as an allergy on purpose: that is the word kitchens act on.)

JAPAN · blue-light emergencies
🚑 119 · ambulance + fire 🚓 110 · police
Say slowly: "Kyūkyū desu" (救急です, "it's a medical emergency") or "Kaji desu" (fire) on 119 · "Keisatsu o onegaishimasu" on 110 · then your location: the address on the taxi card of the current chapter, or the nearest station name + exit number. Ambulances are free in Japan; the hospital bill is AIG's.
Japan Visitor Hotline · JNTO · 24/7 · English📞 050-3816-2787 lost passport routing, medical interpreting, disaster info. Dial +81-50-3816-2787 from the Israeli SIM.
Earthquake / typhoonfollow the phone's alert, get away from glass, don't run outside during shaking · NHK World app has English alerts · trains stop, hotels stay open.
EMBASSY OF ISRAEL · TOKYO
3 Nibancho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo 102-0084 · nearest: Kojimachi (Yurakucho Line) / Hanzomon (Hanzomon Line) · consular hours Mon-Fri 10:00-13:00
📞 03-3264-0911 ✉ consular@tokyo.mfa.gov.il ✉ herum.tokyo@gmail.com · after-hours emergencies only embassy on Maps
LOST OR STOLEN · the order of operations
Passport1) nearest kōban (police box): report, get the 紛失届 / 盗難届 receipt (lost / theft report), you need it for everything after · 2) call the embassy, after hours the herum email · 3) emergency travel document takes a few working days: photos + the police receipt + a copy of the passport (keep a photo of the data page in the phone and one in the cloud).
Credit cardblock it in the bank app first, then call the card company's international line from the card's own back-of-card number (photo of it in the phone) · GO app and SmartEX both need the new card added, they were updated once already in Aug 2026.
Phonethe board file and the pins backup live in the cloud, the SIM is replaceable at any AnyFone or Bic Camera · log the theft at a kōban for the record even without cover.
Wallet / casha kōban report, then the JNTO hotline for what to do in that city · Japan's lost-and-found actually works: ask the station office and the kōban of the district first.
